group_assessment.weighting: A Taiwanese hospital group (Chung Shan Medical University Hospital, from the affiliations) running candidate-SNP case-control work on WWOX in several cancers. Primary for a regional HCC series; not a WWOX loss-of-function or neurological group. Genotype counts weighed above the sentences claiming expression effects and biomarker utility.

entries.proposition: The significant case-control finding is a protective rare allele: carriers of the rs73569323 T allele are 6 of 354 patients and 39 of 708 controls (Table 2), with no association for the other four SNPs.
entries.snippet: individuals carrying C/T or C/T+T/T at rs73569323 exhibited a 0.305-fold (95% CI: 0.126–0.741) or 0.299-fold (95% CI: 0.123–0.724; both p <0.05) lower risk of HCC, respectively.

entries.proposition: The vascular-invasion association of rs12918952 is a subgroup result (252 male patients, 28 carriers, 9 with invasion) among five SNPs and many clinical variables, with no multiplicity statement in the Methods.
entries.snippet: we observed that the trend of G/A+G/G genotype of WWOX rs12918952 for vascular invasion risk (p = 0.024) was higher in male patients with HCC.

entries.proposition: The consequence class of rs12918952 is stated three ways in one paper: an exonic SNP that may change an amino acid, an Ala-179-Thr substitution, and a synonymous variant in exon 6.
entries.snippet: Rs12918952 and rs3764340, which are located in the exon of WWOX, were selected in this study since these 2 SNPs may result from amino acid changes

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 1E: a GTEx boxplot titled 'Liver eQTL rs12918952 ENSG00000186153.12' of rank-normalised expression for Homo Ref (N = 25), Het (N = 40) and Homo Alt (N = 32); the medians step down across the three classes and the boxes overlap. The class sizes imply an alternate-allele frequency near 54 percent, against about 5 percent A allele in this paper's controls, and the paper does not say which allele GTEx calls 'Alt'.
